gate_protocol.transport: stdout flushed ASCII line; stdin exactly one byte X per gate; EINTR retry only
gate_protocol.failure: Publish/flush error, EOF, non-X byte or read error fails; no completion JSON on gate failure. Existing runtime cleanup/fail-stop remains authoritative.

env_contract: Absent permitted; other values rejected; existing required and trace/timing-only optional variables unchanged; existing relevant environment receipt unchanged; no environment mutation.
historical_env_consumers: Neither fixed optional name occurs in validation/pr6-restore source at capture. Prefill already aliases copy=cs with copy_owned=false independently; verifier remains excluded. These accepted names give no new behavioral guarantee.
deadlines: Existing initialization 600s and retirement/head/cleanup budgets unchanged. runtime-ready hold consumes initialization budget; Main external supervisor must bound each hold and total runtime with room for remaining load. Other three holds outside initialization deadline. No new process watchdog.
measurement: Original timer placements unchanged: initialization includes runtime-ready inspection; prefill_run including final callback copy, prefill_init and cleanup exclude new holds; wall_to_receipt includes all holds. No speed claim from this proposal.
owners: No new queue, allocation, submission, wait, free or owner mutation in gate helper. All Runtime and host buffer lifetimes retained; after-cleanup only after r.close returns successfully.
required_main_gates: complete patch review against captured preimage
integration only after current build closes
supervised model-small safety/correctness/fault and cleanup qualification
